Privacy policy

Last updated 2026-10-24

What the game stores

Crease saves your progress, streak and statistics in your own browser using local storage. This data stays on your device. We do not receive it and we do not have accounts.

Analytics

This site may use a privacy-friendly analytics service that counts visits without cookies.

Advertising

This site may show ads from third-party networks in the future. If it does, those networks may use cookies, and this page will be updated to say so.

Fonts

Pages load fonts from Google Fonts, which receives your IP address when the fonts are requested.

Contact

Questions about this policy: the site owner (add a contact email by setting CONTACT_EMAIL when you build).
